meta.eyebrow: EX-9 · Search page in a sandbox · engineer's view
meta.title: The sandbox search page by Monday is buildable, but two open choices decide its shape: index and size
meta.lede: The ticket asks for one search page. The mock-up attached to it also needs a typo-tolerant index. The old page is slower and smaller than either. Until two things are settled we cannot approve a plan. Ticket [r1].
meta.foot: Source: an invented example. Colours are the author's reading, not a measurement.

nodes.title: One search page, sandbox, by Monday
nodes.plain: The ticket lists one page with a text box and a result list.

nodes.title: Also typo tolerance
nodes.plain: The mock-up shows suggestions for misspelled words. That is not in the ticket list.
nodes.needs: Is typo tolerance in scope for the sandbox?

nodes.title: old-search: exact match only
nodes.plain: The old page works and is proven. It matches whole words only and is slow on long lists.

nodes.title: Sandbox exists; index size unknown
nodes.plain: The sandbox is an empty scaffold. No one has said how many records the index will hold.

problem: We are asked to rebuild a proven page in an empty sandbox by a fixed day, but the ticket, the mock-up and the old page describe three different things [r1], and we do not yet know how big the index will be.
